en.headline: Chan Wai-lap’s ceramic bathhouse installation continues at Oi! until 30 August
en.dek: The free exhibition Jeremy’s Bathhouse at Oil Street Art Space features a heart-shaped pool of more than 1,200 handmade tiles and mist effects exploring bathing cultures and connection.
body: Hong Kong artist Chan Wai-lap’s solo exhibition Jeremy’s Bathhouse remains on view at Oil Street Art Space (Oi!) in North Point until 30 August as part of the Oi! Spotlight series.

The installation extends the artist’s ongoing Swimming series and draws on bathhouse cultures across time and place. A heart-shaped pool made from more than 1,200 handcrafted ceramic tiles forms the centrepiece; visitors may step into the space and put on slippers as part of the experience. Another work presents ceramic soaps in varied colours, with timed mist releases that soften the atmosphere.
Admission is free. The exhibition is presented by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department at 12 Oil Street. Opening hours and access details are available on the venue’s official channels.

zh.headline: 陳惠立「左旋們浴場」陶瓷裝置展油街實現至8月30日
zh.dek: 免費展覽以逾1,200塊手工陶瓷磚組成心形浴池，結合霧氣效果，探討浴場文化與人際連結，北角油街實現舉行。
body: 香港藝術家陳惠立個展「油街焦點——左旋們浴場」繼續於北角油街實現展出，至8月30日結束，屬「油街焦點」系列項目。
展覽延續藝術家「游泳」系列，靈感來自各地浴場文化。中心裝置《左旋之心》由超過1,200塊手工陶瓷磚組成心形設計，參觀者可走進空間並穿上拖鞋體驗。另一作品展示不同顏色的陶瓷肥皂，並定時釋放霧氣，營造朦朧氣氛。
展覽免費入場，由康樂及文化事務署主辦，地址為油街12號。開放時間及詳情可查閱場地官方資料。
